# Conservative Party Manifesto 2024: Summary

## Economic Policy

The manifesto outlines plans to reduce employee National Insurance from 12% to 6% by April 2027, representing a £1,350 annual reduction for average earners. Self-employed individuals would see their main National Insurance rate abolished entirely. The party commits to maintaining fiscal rules requiring public sector net debt to fall and borrowing to remain below 3% of GDP.

Business support measures include maintaining corporation tax rates, extending "full expensing" to leasing when conditions allow, and a ten-point plan for SMEs covering business rates relief, VAT threshold reviews, and improved access to finance.

## Taxation and Pensions

The "Triple Lock Plus" would ensure State Pensions rise annually by the highest of inflation, earnings, or 2.5%, while introducing a new age-related personal allowance to prevent pensioners being drawn into income tax. Child Benefit reforms would shift to household-based assessment, with withdrawal beginning at £120,000 combined income.

## Immigration

Proposals include a legally binding annual cap on migration covering work and family visas, with Parliament voting on levels each year. The Rwanda removal scheme would continue, alongside reforms to asylum rules and increased visa fees.

## Defence and Security

Defence spending would increase to 2.5% of GDP by 2030, with investment in munitions production, nuclear modernisation, and continued Ukraine support. A National Defence and Resilience Plan would address preparedness for various threats.

## Public Services

NHS spending would increase above inflation annually, with plans for 92,000 additional nurses and 28,000 more doctors. Mental health support would expand to all schools by 2030. Housing targets include 1.6 million new homes through brownfield development, planning reforms, and continued Help to Buy schemes.

## Energy and Environment

The approach includes annual North Sea oil and gas licensing rounds, trebling offshore wind capacity, and building new nuclear capacity including Small Modular Reactors. Green levies on household bills would be kept lower than 2023 levels.

## Education and Skills

Plans include mandatory National Service for 18-year-olds (military or civic options), 100,000 additional apprenticeships, and the Advanced British Standard for 16-19 education. Mobile phones would be banned during school hours.
